title: 模型设置、批量替换与模板自动切换状态审计

coverage.feature: Scan / guarded apply / successful-edit history / inverted undo
coverage.reason: ReplaceLifecycle models one guarded reference and undo result; scan projects/missing/errors, schedule/app-setting backends, partial batch, chain grouping, retry append and pruning read in source but not exhaustively modeled.
Catalog is an opaque capability input. Probe runners may spend provider quota; no real probe or CLI was executed.
TemplateSwitch uses global/project scope and command apply/undo boundaries; capture/snapshot/CRUD remain source-read-only.

coverage.feature: Fresh preview / quota preflight / write / session results / undo
coverage.reason: TemplateSwitch models finite preflight/write/aggregate sessions; native session switching and manual template undo are source-read-only. Apply recomputes preview (306-307); GUI preview itself is not a CAS promise.

coverage.feature: Quota rule first hit / bottom line / auto revert / poller
coverage.reason: TemplateSwitch bounds one eligible rule per valid scope and drift gating. Ordering, notification dedupe, missing projects, polling backoff and auto-revert eligibility predicates read in source, not separately explored.
Read schema commands/upsert semantics: scope retained on template updates, bottom-line uniqueness per scope, dependent rule deletion, ordered rules. No config or DB writes were performed.
fetch_usage uses cached report; window percentage and exhausted-account aggregation read. The model consumes verdicts instead of running provider/CLI reports.
Exact mapping and verbatim fallback traced only; provider identity remains an I/O boundary.

coverage.feature: Scoped role resolution and guarded YAML edits
coverage.reason: RoleScope models project-over-global roles and global-over-project named pins. Alias cycles/unset fallback, validation, byte preservation, atomic guarded writes, legacy refusal and batching read in source only.

coverage.feature: Global fallback chain splice / rename / guarded write
coverage.reason: Fresh locked read, grouped planning, verification and atomic write inspected. No source-level assertion replay or live config write.
Project/user/extensions/plugins/builtin discovery and first-name-wins precedence inspected; no external catalog or arbitrary directory traversal model.

coverage.feature: Scope / scan / preview / apply / retry / undo / late navigation
coverage.reason: ReplaceOwnership models apply success/failure and start-over ownership; ReplaceLifecycle models stale stored value and undo; ModelCapability models target/level changes. Multiwrite, history read ordering and undo navigation are not fully explored.

coverage.feature: Plan building / matching / per-row thinking sanitization
coverage.reason: ModelCapability uses supported levels and row override sanitization; aliases/globs/provider-sensitive matching, chain dedup/conflict and full buildPlan are source-read-only.
Catalog kind groups, probe-kind mapping, thinking eligibility and single-flight catalog load inspected. Catalog I/O not executed.

coverage.feature: Target group and supported thinking picker
coverage.reason: ModelCapability covers supported options and search target conversion; popover/search/rendering is source-read-only.
ModelCapability abstracts one same-kind override with unsupported level removal. Rendering and every row permutation remain read-only.
Failed item retry and live RPC model/thinking/get_state contracts traced; Runtime owns downstream execution state. No actual session RPCs issued.
Stored edits, restored-value presentation and per-item errors inspected; UI expansion itself is not modeled.
Usage selection/probe pending/success/error rendering inspected. Probe invocation is out of runtime audit to avoid API cost.
Invalidate role/config/settings/schedule consumers traced. Consumer stores outside this slice retain their owners.

coverage.feature: Snapshot generation / mutation publication / status reads
coverage.reason: TemplateSnapshot exposes late pre-save read overwriting a published successful mutation; confirmed through actual public store actions. Status reads/forced supersession are source-read-only, with forced-read control replayed.

coverage.feature: Mount refresh / subscription ownership / capture / duplicate
coverage.reason: Subscription cancellation cleanup and editor/apply modal ownership inspected; capture/navigation interleavings not separately verified.

coverage.feature: Captured/duplicate draft / save / absent vs null roles
coverage.reason: Save publishes full backend response via setSnapshot at 153. Pending busy/escape and null/absent editor values inspected, not independently modeled.
Scope filtering, dependent-rule warning and snapshot publication inspected. Confirm dialog and backend mutation I/O are not driven.
Actual save caller of publication at 440-442 traced; the model begins at its returned snapshot, not a simulated UI click. Rule validation/CRUD not replayed.
TemplateSwitch models quota refusal and explicit force. Preview loading and modal rendering remain source-read-only; backend recomputes preview on apply.
Manual undo confirmation, IPC and refresh traced. Native undo not invoked.

coverage.feature: Scope filters / quota provider labels / rule defaults
coverage.reason: Scope helpers and quota presentation inspected; mapping remains an opaque provider identity boundary.

coverage.feature: Queued scoped reads/writes and cached snapshots
coverage.reason: RoleScope models scoped results; source ownership checks skip old-project read publication and queue writes. Full cache warming and cross-revision races remain read-only.
useSave mount ownership, pending/saved/error states, role choices and alias presentation inspected; not rendered or formally expanded.
Name uniqueness, value requirement, pending lock, scoped write and error preservation inspected; no role definition creation is implied.

coverage.feature: Global default / session project choice / navigation
coverage.reason: RoleScope models explicit global/project selection; source no-project disabled state and project picker fallback are read-only.

coverage.feature: Role precedence / aliases / validation / fallback helper
coverage.reason: Frontend mirrors resolver: unknown/cycle errors do not silently fall through; alias and syntactic capability handling inspected. Full agent-resolution chain not checked by RoleScope.

coverage.feature: Builtin roles / suffixes / fallback chain types
coverage.reason: Explicit absent/empty/list fallback meanings and known suffix splitting inspected; role values accept suffix syntax without a catalog capability guarantee.

coverage.feature: Draft reorder / apply / unset / disabled chain
coverage.reason: Committed draft resync, valid cleaned rows, mode actions and record write inspected; whole-record RPC remains I/O.
Pure display/match helpers inspected; no independently changing lifecycle to statechart.

models.name: TemplateSnapshot
models.regenerate: node "$STATECHART_SCRIPT" from-spec TemplateSnapshot.tla --config TemplateSnapshot.cfg --map TemplateSnapshot.map.mjs --out snapshot-out --title "模板列表保存与迟到读取" --png --expect-broken MutationSurvives
models.limits: One snapshot read, one successful save publication; reply value captured at read start; errors terminate the read. Forced-read supersession is exercised by the consumer replay, not expanded in this model.

models.name: ReplaceLifecycle
models.regenerate: node "$STATECHART_SCRIPT" from-spec ReplaceLifecycle.tla --config ReplaceLifecycle.cfg --map ReplaceLifecycle.map.mjs --out replace-out --title "批量替换与保护性撤销" --png --cover
models.limits: One scanned stored reference with three concrete values, one apply and at most one undo. A failed compare preserves the manual value. Batch partial results, retry accumulation, history pruning and later scans are source-read-only. undoValue captures the observable value at undo return, not a promise that future external writes cannot change it.

models.name: ReplaceOwnership
models.regenerate: node "$STATECHART_SCRIPT" from-spec ReplaceOwnership.tla --config ReplaceOwnership.cfg --map ReplaceOwnership.map.mjs --out ownership-out --title "离开替换流程后的迟到结果" --png --cover
models.limits: One nonempty apply, one start-over navigation and one deferred rescan. Success/failure of IPC is opaque. Navigation invalidates presentation ownership but does not cancel a started backend write. Rescan failure, overlapping multiple writes, unmount and restart are read-only/out-of-model.

models.name: TemplateSwitch
models.regenerate: node "$STATECHART_SCRIPT" from-spec TemplateSwitch.tla --config TemplateSwitch.cfg --map TemplateSwitch.map.mjs --out switch-out --title "模板额度切换与恢复" --png --cover
models.limits: One valid scope and one first-hit rule; quota verdict is an opaque finite input. Force is either explicit confirmation or same-scope bottom line. One atomic write with success/failure and aggregate session outcomes; current enabled auto-revert with window due is fixed eligible, then drift prevents restoration. No concurrent native writes, DB failures after file commit, scheduler time progression, multi-rule ordering or live provider probes are explored.

models.name: RoleScope
models.regenerate: node "$STATECHART_SCRIPT" from-spec RoleScope.tla --config RoleScope.cfg --map RoleScope.map.mjs --out scope-out --title "模型角色与点名覆盖范围" --png --cover
models.limits: One global key, one existing project key, role vs named-override tables, global deletion and scope navigation. Project starts configured and is not deleted in this bound. Alias recursion, agent discovery and full override > declaration > task > session precedence are source-read-only, not fully verified by this per-layer model.

models.name: ModelCapability
models.regenerate: node "$STATECHART_SCRIPT" from-spec ModelCapability.tla --config ModelCapability.cfg --map ModelCapability.map.mjs --out capability-out --title "替换目标的类型与思考能力约束" --png --cover
models.limits: Two chat targets with disjoint supported thinking levels, one search target and one row override. Model-default is a separate no-suffix value. Other model kinds, arbitrary catalogs, capability discovery, generic role suffix syntax and provider API compatibility are source-read-only/opaque.
